_cronsReference.name: send-followups
_cronsReference.description: Check non-responsive leads every 7 min; send_followups itself only sends inside CONTACT_WINDOWS (08:21-20:53 CAT), so off-hours ticks are no-ops. Each lead fires at its own jittered minute for natural human send times

_cronsReference.name: send-reminders
_cronsReference.description: Customer and plumber reminders - booking, morning, 2hr, 30min alerts

_cronsReference.name: send-scheduled-followups
_cronsReference.description: Dispatches staff-queued ScheduledFollowup rows over WhatsApp or email, including the email follow-ups for delayed leads. send_followups also calls this on every tick, so this service is the tighter-cadence path rather than the only one

_note: This file applies to EVERY service in the project and its startCommand overrides each service's own. Cron services therefore share start.sh and pick their job via the PLUMBOT_CRON env var. The list above is documentation only - Railway does not read it.
